item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 11:25 PM 27 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Capalonga, JosePanganiban, Paracale, Labo, Vinzons, Talisay, SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz), #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Goa, SanJose, Presentacion), #Catanduanes(Pandan, Caramoran, Bagamanoc, Panganiban and Viga) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(Daet, Mercedes, Basud), #CamarinesSur(Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Caramoan) and #Masbate(SanPascual) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
